description.narrative: The principal objectives of the project are to: (i) improve road transport service and safety conditions between the capital at Mbabane and the industrial areas near Mhlambanyatsi; and (ii) improve regional and local traffic access and circulation to the rural communities and agricultural areas in the project area. The road will facilitate access to the timber plantations of Tonkwane Estates and Tyrone Timber and will also serve the local population of the Siphocosini valley.
